accepted_direction: No admission.lock or mutable mutex reaping. Native primitive alone owns SQLite anchor descriptors; trusted callback helpers must not reopen/close anchor. Fixed SQL and metadata-only in-lock checks align OI01/03/04.

Two independent confirmations resolve inode bootstrap: precursor plan explicitly has absent identities; issuer plan is generated only after actual precursor identities exist. No issuer/key/grant on first stage.

Exact issuer bytes are frozen privately before second READY and published create-only without replacement. Foreign/malformed/uncertain state remains held. Concurrency and crash handling still require actual final host tests.

Raw artifact-byte SHA256, JCS unsigned payload digest and domain-separated HMAC inputs are explicitly distinguished. Strict32-byte standard padded base64 and timing-safe MAC verification are coherent requirements.
Protected same-UID namespace is the explicit origin trust anchor; colocated MAC/key does not claim external authentication. No ordinary authority, role or opaque-handle bypass.

Installation HEAD/package/constitution/policy observations are immutable historical observations. Fresh approvals bind current exact inputs; renewal/retry cannot migrate original scope. Unsupported issuer protocols refuse; no auto-rotation.

Revision2 ten-cell intent_authority_matrix is retained in entirety; expired/revoked complete outputs settle metadata only, partial output cannot resume domain writes. Native SQL rollback cannot erase immutable domain intent truth.
56GREEN lower native receipt qualifies only exact lower primitive on stated environment; neither actual host resolver/adapter nor public workflow is accepted.

findings.subject: clock.units/sources/review_bounds
findings.finding: The specified floor(os.uptime()*1000) is labelled monotonic system-uptime milliseconds, but actual Node24.22.0 Darwin uv_uptime uses time(NULL)-KERN_BOOTTIME and returns whole seconds. Multiplication by1000 does not supply independent monotonic provenance or millisecond resolution. A300000ms monotonic-only review bound measured in truncated seconds can permit up to nearly1000ms more real elapsed time; wall grant bound does not repair review-only quantization. No wall-change/backwards exploit was executed or asserted.

primary_sources.supports: Darwin source uses time(NULL), KERN_BOOTTIME, whole-second subtraction.
Different uv_hrtime implementation uses mach_continuous_time; candidate only, not adopted by this review.
Linux uptime comes from /proc/uptime or CLOCK_BOOTTIME with a seconds-only fallback; platform behavior differs.

findings.actual_evidence: clock-observation.json: actual Nodev24.22.0/libuv1.52.1 Darwin parent+child; wall elapsed127ms while uptime_ms unchanged. No system clock, boot or suspend mutated.
findings.required_resolution: Freeze actual qualified monotonic source, common boot/host epoch and resolution/rounding/suspend/clock-adjustment semantics for grants and review handles. Keep wall bounds independently. Either replace uptime with a qualified monotonic observation or explicitly establish required guarantees/uncertainty and conservative lifetime treatment. Do not label os.uptime as proved monotonic merely because local samples agree.

Freeze integer/decimal/range/expiry inequalities, predecessor/boot comparisons, and the complete expiry/reboot/renew/revoke/settlement transition table. Test actual cross-process observations and deterministic boundary/error cases.

Freeze exact closed variants/field lists for issuer, approval, renewal, revocation, lease, phase-intent, phase-completion and safe projections; exact sequence/predecessor/phase/effect-output bounds, immutable scope and canonical namespace identity encoding. Preserve every retained intent-matrix cell. Define an acyclic digest dependency graph: if legacy issuer provision_plan_sha256 survives, it must not hash the same final plan that already binds that issuer file hash; name its pre-byte/seed-plan meaning explicitly.

Freeze bounded raw UTF8 ingest and descriptor-safe copies, exact JCS implementation, canonical signed file+LF equality or strict duplicate-key parsing BEFORE permissive JSON.parse loses duplicate provenance; lone surrogate/numeric-lexeme/key ordering limits; exact domain and key validation. Ordinary JSON.parse plus post-schema validation alone cannot discharge duplicate-key refusal. No same-byte raw-vs-payload digest substitution.

Freeze typed child-effect inventory and consumer/source census for both bootstrap stages and every metadata transition: private0700 dirs, seed publication/readback, writable SQLite lock acquisition/closed SQL/rollback/close, exact issuer/grant/intent/completion/lease publish, exact quarantine removal and indeterminate custody. No raw anchor descriptor read/close anywhere in live connection callbacks; no native lock from no-write/preconfirmation paths. Register exact capability/handle dispatch only with actual adapter, role/action/argv/consent/policy witnesses.

Freeze five-mode original-argv/output matrix plus separate Architect provisioning grammar, three actual TTY streams, exact confirmation/handle expiry, cancellation/drift/indeterminate outcomes and safe private projections. Preserve original action initiation and unchanged generic effect ledger. Stage2 retries must distinguish exact reviewed issuer bytes, already-observed complete issuer, competing different issuer, owned staged uncertainty and foreign remnants; no different-byte winner may satisfy a stale READY plan.

After concrete contracts and authentic RED, qualify final host adapter on actual supported filesystem/direct+linked worktree/installed Node: callback composition with no raw anchor closes, contention/SIGKILL, no sidecars,2stage crash/retry, namespace/issuer substitution, MAC/parser secrecy, all intent/expiry/renew/revoke/recover schedules. Native56GREEN is prerequisite only. Then actual real-index/staged inventory/public installed workflow and existing protected release gates remain separate.

not_design_contradictions: The two-stage precursor leaves inert seed after cancellation; this is explicitly reviewed scope, not a claim of zero filesystem effects after first confirmation.
Immutable installation bindings can coexist with new current-binding approvals; supported-protocol verification and explicit scope matching are implementation obligations, not automatic migration.
JCS signing and raw whole-file reference digests are coherent because their byte domains are named separately. Exact field/parser implementation remains pending.

Retained issuer provision_plan_sha256 could create a hash cycle only if mapped to the same issuer-byte-bound final plan. V3 has not frozen these fields, so this is a schema-freeze hazard, not an asserted existing contradiction.

primary_standards.supports: Separate close of same DB file can cancel process advisory locks; future helper composition must preserve descriptor lifetime.
JCS input constraints include no duplicate object property names and IEEE754-compatible numeric values.

bounds: Design review only. No schema/action/effect/native runtime implementation, no source acceptance, no installed adapter acceptance, no release or downstream effects.
